name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
description: Washed heirloom varieties grown at 2,000 m. Floral and tea-like, with a bright citrus finish. Our most-loved pour-over coffee.

name: Colombia Huila
description: A sweet, balanced everyday coffee from smallholders around Pitalito. Great as filter or a bright espresso.

name: Ember House Espresso
description: Our café blend. Syrupy and chocolatey, built to shine with milk.

name: Kenya Nyeri AA
description: SL28 and SL34 from the Gikanda cooperative. Juicy, complex and unmistakably Kenyan.

name: Sumatra Mandheling
description: Wet-hulled and full-bodied, with low acidity and a long earthy finish.

name: Cold Brew Blend
description: Coarse-ground and ready for your fridge. Smooth, sweet and low in bitterness.

name: Swiss Water Decaf
description: Chemical-free decaf that still tastes like coffee. 99.9% caffeine free.

name: Ember Burr Grinder
description: A quiet, consistent electric burr grinder for everything from espresso to cold brew.
